description: Open the enchantment table at (x,y,z), insert an item (and lapis lazuli if available), and read or apply an enchantment offer. Omit `choice` to just return the three offers (top/middle/bottom slots 0/1/2). Provide `choice` (0-2) to apply that offer and take the enchanted item back. Requires line of sight / reach to the table and lapis lazuli in inventory to actually enchant.

choice.description: Offer slot to apply (0=top,1=middle,2=bottom). Omit to only read offers.

item.description: Item to enchant (name or id); must be in inventory

name: enchant_item
